definitions.explanation: Marks the person, medium or experience through which something happens or is learned: an intermediary ({友人|ゆうじん}を{通|とお}して), a channel (メディアを{通|とお}して), or an experience ({仕事|しごと}を{通|とお}して{学|まな}ぶ).
After a stretch of time such as {一年|いちねん} or {一生|いっしょう}, means throughout the whole of it, without a break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧を{通|とお}して⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Light comes in through the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧を{通|とお}して⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}った→知り合う：03072_shiriau⟧。
examples.english: I got to know her through a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧を{通|とお}して、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}びました→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned a great deal through volunteer work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧を{通|とお}して⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: It is warm all year round.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四季|しき}→四季：11809_shiki⟧を{通|とお}して⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: This mountain can be enjoyed in every season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生涯|しょうがい}→生涯：03229_shougai⟧を{通|とお}して、⟦{貧|まず}しい→貧しい：02349_mazushii⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}き→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: Throughout his life, he kept working for the poor.

notes:
The て-form of ⟦{通|とお}す→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (to pass through) after ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Before a noun it becomes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}した→通す：02300_toosu⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会い：03445_deai⟧ (a meeting made through work).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通ずる：31647_tsuuzuru⟧: through; throughout — nearly interchangeable; a little more formal, and preferred for channels of communication such as ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通ずる：31647_tsuuzuru⟧
- ⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧: by means of — names the means or the cause, not a path or go-between
